names.name: Kayan tattooing
names.said: Women's forearms and thighs, worked over years

when.label: Hose and McDougall describe the full sequence in 1912

practice.note: Tattooed by women, for women, over several years and several sittings.

text.what: Upriver Borneo, where the tattooists were women and the work went on a woman's forearms, thighs and feet across years.
text.story: Hose and McDougall set down the sequence, the fees and the taboos in 1912 — which is why a practice that thinned out is describable at all, and also why the description is an outsider's. The Kayan of Borneo are not the Kayan of Myanmar; the names collide and the peoples do not.

text_th.what: บอร์เนียวตอนใน ช่างสักเป็นผู้หญิง สักให้ผู้หญิง ที่แขน ต้นขา และเท้า ใช้เวลาหลายปี
